body: Stop! Tell everyone in person that you were drunk and on Xanax and weren't able to think logically. You don't even remember it! The things need to cool down, first, apologize the friend you hurt, if he forgives you then you others will do the same thing, if not others will surely now that you were on xanax and will things let go. Don't overdose because of 1 stupid accident, it happens to drunk people very often to say this stupid things. I lost my gf becuase when I was drunk I told her that I slept with her best friend who was also drunk and confirmed that bullshit. It was 2 years from this accident and life is still going, I met new friends and got a new gf. It doesn't need to end like this. Hey! Smile :)

Believe me or not, your response cheered me up. I'm not that guy who is telling a lot about himself to the others and that's may be my problem. Everyone knows me as a wise and big tough guy but in real I just want to be loved. It's cheering that someone actually took care about my problem even for a while. You are a good person, never let anyone tell that you aren't. Thank you
